rows.title: If a native .json résumé's own "name" is not a string, the editor and Dashboard crash on every visit and every synced device, or Rename stops working
rows.summary: Now: normalizeResume (withTextFields) stores the record's own name as text: a number as its digits, a list as its text, and an object, blank or missing name as 'Untitled Resume' ('Cover Letter' for a letter). The card, editor header, Rename, Delete prompt and /new all get text; a name that is already text is kept exactly.

review.notes: Reviewed 61cdf4e3 against origin/claude/r4-green (now 475a5ade; the branch merges cleanly and upstream changed nothing near textFields.js or normalizeResume.js). Root cause: withTextFields made every text field text except the record's own name; recordName now does it inside normalizeResume, which every way a record comes in passes through: readStore, importResume (native .json, JSON Resume, PDF/Word/Markdown), syncMerge/mergeResumeLists (including a signed-out stash brought back by planInitialSync), other-tab reload, demo restore (buildRestore/privateOriginal) and PublicResume. Every reader of resume.name (ResumeCard, EditorHeader, Rename, Delete prompt, /new, JobForm/OverviewTab/ListView resume pickers, letter sources, duplicate's '(Copy)') reads store records, so none can meet a non-text name. Fail-first is real: run 36644524664's failfirst job reversed the diff and the test failed (# fail 3), then passed with it restored; the passing fourth case guards that a text name is kept exactly and that a second normalise returns the same object. Full node suite 6/6 and lint green on d517ab91 (run 36645314956). Side effects checked: updatedAt untouched, so no sync write or merge win, and every device normalises identically; the unchanged-object fast path still holds for a text name; no import cycle (letters.js/newResume.js import only demoSeed, defaultDataContent and pageSize, none back to the normaliser); the v13 withOldLetterMarked migration runs after withTextFields but only matches name === 'Cover Letter', which is kept exactly, and a nameless record becomes 'Untitled Resume' (not a letter), so no record is newly reclassified; storedText never prints an object or calls its toString; export file names read personal.name. Build, Playwright and Cypress were not run for this data-only util change; no e2e fixture relies on a blank or missing record name; the batch gate covers them.

notes: CI run 36644524664 (failfirst + named tests incl. guards 31/71/91 and knowledge-docs) was still running when this report was written; its result must be read back before merge.
